book.name: SAN MATEO
book.title: Mateo Jesucristo ye quetire ojaꞌque niꞌi

content: Jesú cʉ̃ masãꞌque niꞌi
Sauru ʉ̃sã soowʉari nʉmʉ beꞌro soorinʉmʉ nicã, ñamiacã ñaꞌcũrõ boꞌrestedijatiri cura María Magdalena, apego María meꞌrã Jesure yaaꞌcaropʉ ĩꞌarã waꞌacãrã niwã.

Wãcũña marĩrõ diꞌta ʉpʉtʉ narãsãcaro niwʉ̃. Tojo waꞌari cura niꞌcʉ̃ Õꞌacʉ̃rẽ werecoꞌtegʉ ʉꞌmʉsecjʉ̃ dijaticʉ niwĩ. Cʉ̃ Jesure yaaꞌcaropʉ etagʉ, na biꞌáca ʉ̃tãgãrẽ pãocʉ niwĩ. Pãotoja, tiga buꞌipʉ dujicʉ niwĩ.
Cʉ̃ bʉpo yaꞌbaro weronojõ asistecʉ niwĩ. Cʉ̃ yaro suꞌtiro ʉpʉtʉ buticaro niwʉ̃.
Surara cʉ̃rẽ ĩꞌarã, ʉpʉtʉ ui narãsã, wẽrĩꞌcãrã weronojõ bʉrʉqueꞌacãrã niwã.
Õꞌacʉ̃rẽ werecoꞌtegʉ sõꞌonícãrã numiarẽ aꞌtiro nicʉ niwĩ: —Yʉꞌʉre uiticãꞌña. Yʉꞌʉ masĩꞌi, mʉsã Jesú na curusapʉ paabiꞌpe wẽjẽꞌcʉre aꞌmarã weeꞌe.
Aꞌtore marĩmi. Cʉ̃ níꞌcaronojõta masãtojami. Cʉ̃rẽ cũuꞌcarore ĩꞌarã aꞌtia, ni pijisãjãacʉ niwĩ.

Narẽ ĩꞌotoja, “Cʉ̃ buꞌerãrẽ sojaro meꞌrã wererã waꞌaya. Aꞌtiro ni wereya narẽ: ‘Wẽrĩꞌcʉpʉ nimigʉ̃, masãtojacʉ niami. Galileapʉ mʉsã dʉporo waꞌayugʉsami. Topʉ cʉ̃rẽ ĩꞌarãsaꞌa’, ni wereya. Aꞌtere mʉsãrẽ weregʉ aꞌtiapʉ”, nicʉ niwĩ Õꞌacʉ̃rẽ werecoꞌtegʉ.
Cʉ̃ tojo nicã tʉꞌorã, numia Jesure yaaꞌcaropʉ níꞌcãrã maata waꞌa waꞌacãrã niwã. Uimirã, eꞌcatise meꞌrã waꞌacãrã niwã. Jesú buꞌerã níꞌcãrãrẽ quetiwererã waꞌarã omawãꞌcãcãrã niwã.
Na topʉ waꞌari cura Jesú narẽ bajua, añuduticʉ niwĩ. Tojo weecã, cʉ̃ pʉꞌto waꞌa ejaqueꞌa, dʉꞌpocãrĩpʉ ñeꞌe, ẽjõpeocãrã niwã.
Narẽ aꞌtiro nicʉ niwĩ: —Yʉꞌʉre uiticãꞌña. Yʉꞌʉ buꞌerãrẽ Galileapʉ waꞌadutirã waꞌaya. Topʉ yʉꞌʉre ĩꞌarãsama, nicʉ niwĩ.
Surara na ĩꞌaꞌquere ãpẽrãrẽ wereꞌque niꞌi
Numia Jesú buꞌerãrẽ wererã waꞌari cura niꞌcãrẽrã surara Jesure yaaꞌcaropʉ coꞌteꞌcãrã macãpʉ piꞌacãrã niwã. Paꞌia wiorãrẽ nipeꞌtise topʉ waꞌaꞌquere werecãrã niwã.

Na tojo nicã tʉꞌorã, paꞌia wiorã, judío masã bʉcʉrã meꞌrã nerẽcãrã niwã. Na “¿Deꞌro weeroʉati?” ni apocãrã niwã. Na niꞌcãrõnojõ wãcũ, aꞌtiro weecãrã niwã. Masãrẽ nisooato nírã surarare pajiro niyeru wapayecãrã niwã.
Aꞌtiro nicãrã niwã: —Aꞌtiro niña masãrẽ: “Ñamipʉ ʉ̃sã cã́rĩ́ca beꞌro Jesú buꞌerã ejacãrã niama. Eja, cʉ̃ ya upʉre yajawãꞌcãcãrã niama”, niña, nicãrã niwã surarare.
Apeye quẽꞌrãrẽ ninemocãrã niwã: —Pilato Judea diꞌta wiogʉ aꞌtere masĩcã, ʉ̃sã “Diacjʉ̃ta tojo waꞌacaro niapʉ”, nitamurãti. Ʉ̃sã tojo nicã, mʉsãrẽ suꞌrisome. Mʉsãrẽ buꞌiri daꞌresome, nicãrã niwã.

Tojo nicã tʉꞌorã, surara niyeru ñeꞌecãrã niwã. Beꞌro narẽ weredutiꞌcaronojõta weecãrã niwã. Na tojo nise seꞌsa waꞌacaro niwʉ̃. Aꞌtocateropʉ quẽꞌrãrẽ judío masã surara na nisooꞌquere ẽjõpeo ucũdecotima yujupʉ.
Jesú cʉ̃ wẽrĩ masã́ca beꞌro cʉ̃ buꞌerãrẽ “Aꞌtiro weeya” níꞌque niꞌi
Beꞌro ʉ̃sã Jesú buꞌerã once Galileapʉ waꞌawʉ. Jesú cʉ̃ wẽrĩse dʉporo ʉ̃rʉ̃gʉ̃pʉ ʉ̃sãrẽ waꞌadutiꞌcʉpʉ waꞌawʉ.
Topʉ Jesure ĩꞌawʉ̃. Cʉ̃rẽ ĩꞌa ejaqueꞌa, ẽjõpeowʉ. Tojo weemicã, ʉ̃sã niꞌcãrẽrã “¿Cʉ̃́ta nitiba?” ni wãcũwʉ̃.
Beꞌro Jesú ʉ̃sã pʉꞌtopʉ aꞌti, aꞌtiro niwĩ: —Õꞌacʉ̃ yʉꞌʉre wiogʉ sõrõtojami. Nipeꞌtiro ʉꞌmʉse, aꞌti diꞌtare dutimasĩꞌi.
Tojo weerã nipeꞌtirocjãrãpʉre yé quetire wererã waꞌaya. Narẽ mʉsã weronojõ yʉꞌʉ buꞌerã sãjãcã weeya. Narẽ wãmeyerã, yʉꞌʉ pacʉ, yʉꞌʉ, Espíritu Santu wãme meꞌrã wãmeyeya.

Nipeꞌtise yʉꞌʉ mʉsãrẽ dutiꞌquere narẽ yʉꞌti buꞌecã weeya. Narẽ nipeꞌtise nʉmʉrĩ yʉꞌʉ mʉsãrẽ buꞌeꞌquere wereya. Aꞌtere masĩña. Nipeꞌtise nʉmʉrĩ mʉsã meꞌrã ninuꞌcũcʉ̃saꞌa. Téé aꞌti turi peꞌticãpʉ quẽꞌrã mʉsã meꞌrã ninuꞌcũcʉ̃saꞌa, ni werewĩ Jesú.
